name: MemTensor and NVIDIA release MemT-1.0 memory-native models, 36B to 554B total (59B active for Pro)
title: MemTensor and NVIDIA release MemT-1.0 memory-native models, 36B to 554B total (59B active for Pro)
summary: MemT models keep a persistent memory state across interactions through local and trainable hyper memory instead of re-sending history. Nano, Flash and Pro checkpoints are on ModelScope under Apache-2.0, MIT and OpenMDW-1.1; the post reports a 53.08 average across 11 memory benchmarks among parametric-memory methods.
